properties.evidence: The memo that makes loop_status cheap is keyed on the write generation, so it is invalidated by every write. Measured on the live store in the live server configuration: loop_status is 1,291 ms with no write before it and 4,096 ms steady with one small write before each call — a 3.2x tax that lands precisely on a working session, because the tool the loop tells every session to call is the one guaranteed to run in its most expensive state. This is the largest code-side term; load and concurrency are environmental and the baseline itself is only 1.28 s.
